title: Board Central Kinds And Compatibility
description: Implement central board kind catalogs (node, edge, handle, wire) with id-referenced kinds, instance overrides, and unified compatibility pairs with specificity ordering (general < node < edge < handle < wire) plus important flag; wire-draw snap uses compatibility. Extend TS + WASM board.
summary: Centralized board semantic kinds via BoardKindCatalogBundle (handles, wires, nodes, edges) pushed through setBoardKindCatalogsJson; instances expose nodeKind, edgeKind, wireKind overrides in descriptor JSON. Unified BoardKindCompatEntry rules with specificity tiers and important bypass; WASM link snap/commit uses combined wire/handle/node/edge/general matching. BoardCanvas now takes kindCatalogs and kindCompatibility; defaults BOARD_DEFAULT_KIND_CATALOG_BUNDLE wire chain for gestures. Vitest + Rust tests extended; wasm-pack outputs regenerated.
